# Support

Read the [README](README.md) and linked documentation first. Report reproducible bugs or documentation gaps in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/{{repository}}/issues). Include the version or commit, operating system, expected result, actual result, and minimal steps. Remove tokens, personal data, and private paths from logs.

Feature requests should explain the use case and the smallest useful outcome. Use PRs for reviewable changes. For security issues, use [private reporting](SECURITY.md). Maintainers provide support as time permits; no response-time or compatibility guarantee is implied.
